title: Little Bat Sleeps All Day
tagline: Everyone has their own sleepy time
description: Little Bat wakes up when everyone else goes to bed, and goes to sleep when the sun comes up. Little Bat shows you the forest at night, then hangs upside down to sleep at dawn.

characters.name: Little Bat
characters.description: A tiny bat with thin purple wings.

characters.name: Flying Squirrel
characters.description: A flying squirrel who loves the night too.

cues.text: When the sun went down, everyone went to bed.
But Little Bat had just opened her eyes, hanging upside down from a branch.
“Good evening! Time for me to wake up!” Little Bat said.
cues.speaker: doi

cues.text: Flying Squirrel glided over, who loved playing at night too.
“Let’s explore the night forest together!” Flying Squirrel said.
cues.speaker: soc

cues.text: The two friends zoomed through the treetops.
At night, there is a white flower that only blooms under the Moon.
It smelled so sweet and was white as snow.
Little one, tap the night flower!
The sky grew light, and the sun peeked over the hill.
“Time for me to go to sleep,” Little Bat yawned.
cues.speaker: doi

cues.text: Little Bat hung in her cave, wrapped in her wings like a blanket.
You sleep at night, Bat sleeps by day, and everyone needs their sleep.
Good night, little one, cozy as Little Bat in her warm cave.
